payload.prompt: Short forward shift tracking workers moving among construction clutter and partitions; shadows elongate across floor and columns. Viewpoint: short forward shift Use at most one small viewpoint movement. Keep movement restrained, physically coherent and continuous. Do not orbit, fly, float, pass through objects or combine multiple moves. Keep the viewpoint nearly fixed; use one tiny adjustment at most. End state: Presence of people solidifies spatial scale and activity, casting dynamic shadows that animate surfaces. No monster or substitute figure appears. Animate only subjects and objects already visible in the start frame.
